content.text: BAMS is a promising undergraduate course in India nowadays. It is a 5.5-year program that includes a one-year on-field internship. Pass-outs of class 12 can apply to this course if they have qualified in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) which is held once a year by the National Testing Agency (NTA). Just like any other state in the country, there are ample opportunities for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh. In total, there are 8 colleges that offer this undergraduate degree. In this article, we will talk about the admission process, eligibility, fee structure, and top colleges for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh.

sections.heading: BAMS Admission in Chhattisgarh Overview

content.text: NEET is mandatory for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh. Two government colleges, along with 6 private ones, select their students depending on their merit score in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test. Also, they are required to attend the Chhattisgarh BAMS Counselling to enrol themselves in the BAMS colleges. The state counselling is conducted by the Directorate of AYUSH Chhattisgarh . Each year, the cut-off marks for BAMS admission change. So, the willing candidate must stay updated through the AYUSH counselling website of Chhattisgarh. The admission of BAMS in Chhattisgarh is monitored by the Ministry of AYUSH. They regulate the whole admission process of the colleges that offer BAMS admission in India .

sections.heading: BAMS Admission Process in Chhattisgarh

content.text: There are some procedures to follow if you are willing to take BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh. To make it easy to follow, we have provided a step-by-step guide for the BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh.
Step 1: First, appear in the NEET examination and score higher than the cut-off mark set by the Chhattisgarh Department of AYUSH.
Step 2: Register yourself on the official website of the Chhattishgarh AYUSH counselling. It is conducted by the Directorate of AYUSH, Chhattisgarh.
Step 3: Submit all the necessary documents and provide your academic and personal details to fill up the registration form.
Step 4: Attend the counselling session. Use your registration ID to log in to the online portal. There, choose your preferred colleges.
Step 5: After you are allotted a seat at a college, the next step consists of reporting to the college. Carry the seat allotment letter with you while reporting.
Step 6: Completing the document verification by submitting all the relevant documents both in originals and photocopies.

Step 7: The last step is to finalise your candidature. It consists of a fee payment that is required at the time of admission. Pay all the prescribed fees, including hostel, library, miscellaneous, etc.

sections.heading: BAMS Eligibility in Chhattisgarh

content.text: The Directorate of AYUSH Chhattisgarh has listed a set of eligibility criteria for the students who want to take admission in the BAMS program. So, for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh, the following eligibility criteria are to be followed.

items: Candidates must complete their 10+2 (or equivalent) examination from a recognised board with subjects Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) as core subjects
Students must secure a qualifying score in the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG). It is mandatory for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh.
Candidates must score an aggregate of 50% in their Physics, Chemistry, and Biology subjects in the 12th board exam. (For SC/ST students, it is 40%)
Candidates must be aged over 17 years at the time of admission.

sections.heading: Documents Required for Admission

content.text: Certain documents are required for document verification, listed by the Directorate of Ayush, Chhattisgarh. The list of documents that are required for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh are given below.

items: Provisional allotment letter
Admit Cards for the NEET (UG) Exam issued by NTA.
NEET (UG) Result / Rank letter issued by NTA.
Date of Birth Certificate (if the 10th standard Certificate does not bear the same)
Class 10th Passed Certificate and Marksheet.
Class 10+2 Passed Certificate and Marksheet.
Passport-sized photographs.
Transfer Certificate / Migration Certificate.
Proof of identity (Aadhar/ PAN/ Driving License/ Passport/Voter ID)
Caste Certificate (If applicable)
PwD Certificate (If applicable)
Character Certificate
A medical fitness certificate issued by the District Medical Board.

sections.heading: BAMS Fees in Chhattisgarh

content.text: For the fee structure, different colleges are responsible for setting their fees, as the Ministry of AYUSH and the Government of India jointly agreed on giving the state government independence to set the fees for BAMS admission in Chhattisgarh.

While the fees of Government colleges are lower compared to the private ones, the infrastructure and faculty are well-polished. So, the difference in fees is justifiable. For more details about the whole fee structure, visit the official website of the college.
